article.summary_es: Central Synagogue Caring Committee es una cocina comunitaria en Manhattan, incluida en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Sirve comida en la mañana de martes a viernes.
article.summary_en: Central Synagogue Caring Committee is a soup kitchen in Manhattan, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It serves food in the morning Tuesday through Friday.
how_they_help_es: Es una cocina comunitaria según el mapa Food Help NYC.
Está ubicada en 123 E 55th St, Nueva York, NY 10022.
Abre martes, jueves y viernes de 6:30am a 7:30am.
La lista no indica qué alimentos ofrece ni requisitos; pregunte antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: It is a soup kitchen listed on the Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 123 E 55th St, New York, NY 10022.
It is open Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 6:30am to 7:30am.
The listing does not say what food is given or any requirements; ask before going.
